name: pitlane
description: Pitlane — parallel Claude Code sessions in one project, each in a worktree that comes ready to run with its own database and port.

plugins.name: pitlane
plugins.description: Run several Claude Code sessions on one project at the same time without them getting in each other's way. Every new worktree comes ready to run — its settings copied in, its packages installed — with its own database and its own port. /pitlane-setup fits it to your project once; /pitlane-tidy cleans up what finished worktrees leave behind.
